description: Blog Write multi agent AI is a custom multi-agent system designed to autonomously create high-quality, research-driven blogs. Using LangChain, Gemini 2.0-Flash-EXP, and Serper Web Search Tool, it automates planning, writing, and editing to deliver human-like blogs with up-to-date references.
